title: Beyond chorea: a qualitative study of lived experiences in NKX2-1-related disorders
core_idea: Use qualitative methods (one focus group and five individual interviews) with patients and caregivers across Europe and North America to explore preferences, needs, and the daily impact of NKX2-1-related disorders, analyzed using thematic methods informed by grounded theory principles, with the goal of highlighting patient-prioritized aspects of care.
tldr: A qualitative study (focus group + interviews) investigating the preferences, needs, and daily impact of NKX2-1-related disorders among patients and caregivers to support more patient-centered care.
